Congressman Says U.S. Gets Threats ‘Quite Often’ Amid Reports of Iran Plotting ‘Dirty Bomb’

Iran is reportedly developing potential plans to detonate a “dirty bomb” in Washington, D.C., a threat that one member of the House Intelligence Committee called an intimidation tactic. Citing seven U.S. officials, CNN reported on Monday that new U.S. intelligence indicates planning by Iran to target Trump Administration officials in an attack on the capital.
